API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIIPS Control PolicyFirewall IPS Rules Resource Update Firewall IPS Rule
Firewall IPS Rules Resource Update Firewall IPS Rule
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/firewallIpsRules/:ruleId

Updates the IPS Control policy rule information based on the specified ID

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
ruleId
int32
REQUIRED

The unique identifier for the rule

APPLICATION/JSON
BODY

IPS Control policy rule configuration

name
string
REQUIRED

The name of the IPS Control rule

order
int32
REQUIRED

Policy rules are evaluated in ascending numerical order (Rule 1 before Rule 2, and so on), and this field specifies the order of execution for the rule.

rank
int32
REQUIRED

The admin rank specified for the rule based on your assigned admin rank. Admin rank determines the rule order that can be specified for the rule. Admin rank can be configured if it is enabled in the Advanced Settings. .

locations
object[]
locationGroups
object[]
departments
object[]
groups
object[]
users
object[]
timeWindows
object[]
action
string
REQUIRED

The action configured for the rule that must take place if the traffic matches the rule criteria, such as allowing or blocking the traffic or bypassing the rule.

Possible values: [ALLOW, BLOCK_DROP, BLOCK_RESET, BYPASS_IPS]

capturePCAP
boolean

A Boolean value that indicates whether packet capture (PCAP) is enabled or not

state
string

The state of the rule indicating whether it is enabled or disabled

Possible values: [DISABLED, ENABLED]

description
string

The description of the rule

lastModifiedTime
int32

The timestamp when the rule was last modified

lastModifiedBy
object
srcIps
string[]

Source IP addresses or FQDNs to which the rule applies. If not set, the rule is not restricted to a specific source IP address. Each IP entry can be a single IP address, CIDR (e.g., 10.10.33.0/24), or an IP range (e.g., 10.10.33.1-10.10.33.10).

srcIpGroups
object[]
srcIpv6Groups
object[]
destAddresses
string[]

Destination IP addresses or FQDNs to which the rule applies. If not set, the rule is not restricted to a specific destination IP address. Each IP entry can be a single IP address, CIDR (e.g., 10.10.33.0/24), or an IP range (e.g., 10.10.33.1-10.10.33.10).

destIpCategories
object[]
resCategories
object[]
destCountries
string[]

enableFullLogging
boolean

A Boolean value that indicates whether full logging is enabled. A true value indicates that full logging is enabled, whereas a false value indicates that aggregate logging is enabled.

predefined
boolean

A Boolean field that indicates that the rule is predefined by using a true value

defaultRule
boolean

A Boolean value that indicates whether the rule is the Default Cloud IPS Rule or not

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
accessControl
string

The admin’s access privilege to this rule based on the assigned role

Possible values: [NONE, READ_ONLY, READ_WRITE]

id
int32

Unique identifier generated for the rule

name
string
REQUIRED

int32
REQUIRED
